_about: Cleveland (DMA 510) assignment for CBS/FOX regional windows, hand-entered weekly from 506sports.com/nfl.php?wk=N&yr=2026 (spec 7.17). Keyed by NFL week, then ESPN event id or 'AWAY@HOME'. cleveland=true -> the game is on the grid on that network; false -> OUT_OF_MARKET (Around the League strip). Browns games never need an entry (local team rule in adapters/espn.py). Games in a regional window with no entry render as UNVERIFIED and stay off the grid until entered.
